name_en: Choju namasu — a sesame-miso salad of daikon, carrot, and fried tofu
summary_ja: すった白ごまに味噌と厚揚げ、からしと酢を練り合わせ、千切り大根や人参、さやえんどうを和える福井の正月なます。名前の通り長生きを願う縁起物とされ、法事や報恩講の膳にも並ぶという。
summary_en: Ground sesame is worked into a paste with miso, thick fried tofu, mustard, and vinegar, then tossed with shredded daikon, carrot, and snap peas — a New Year salad whose name literally wishes long life, also said to appear at memorial services and Honkoko.
source_title: 長寿なます 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省

name_en: Gonza — daikon and pounded soybean simmered together plain
summary_ja: 水で戻して木槌でつぶした保存食「打ち豆」と千切り大根を、醤油で煮るだけの素朴な一品。福井市東部に伝わり、報恩講の男衆の寄り合いや近所のもらい風呂のお茶請けにも出されたと伝わる。
summary_en: Softened soybeans pounded flat and dried — called 'uchimame' — are simmered plainly with shredded daikon in soy sauce. Passed down in eastern Fukui city, it is said to have been served at men's gatherings during Honkoko and as a snack when neighbors shared a bath.
source_title: ごんざ／ごんじなます 福井県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
